Explain The Issue Of Combat Power

Chapter 32 Explain the problem of combat power

Some readers said that the combat power collapsed, but that is not the case.

Because this is a system article, I did not mention some default cheats. I thought everyone knew about them, but some readers really did not understand.

For a normal person, his strength fluctuates with his state.

When he has a cold or diarrhea, he is definitely weaker than normal.

For example, after the horse king is infected, it is not certain whether he can beat an adult man.

But the protagonist is different.

The attributes of the system panel are fixed.

That is to say, in theory, the protagonist is always at the peak of strength.

This is where the problem arises.

If the battle lasts for a long time, will the protagonist's strength decrease as his physical strength is consumed?

After the protagonist is injured, will his strength decrease?

After the decrease, will the system's attributes still count?

After many system writers have practiced it many times, they came to a conclusion.

That is, the protagonist's strength will not decrease, otherwise it will be very poisonous and unpleasant.

In other words, a cheat with infinite physical strength is defaulted.

This is the only way to avoid logical bugs.

When you play Mount and Blade, if you don't lose blood, you can ride a horse and run through a large group of soldiers, and then kill them one by one. This is the reason.

As for injuries, there is a default hack that locks blood for minor injuries.

As for serious injuries, under normal circumstances, the protagonist cannot be seriously injured.

Because he is the protagonist, Bigger is here.

But if the plot requires that the protagonist is seriously injured, then the attributes of the panel will be ignored.

Under these two conditions, the protagonist is a humanoid robot powered by a nuclear reactor with unlimited stamina and minor injuries.

A normal person would be exhausted after killing a few people, but the protagonist can keep on killing.

Besides, the opponents are all ordinary soldiers, without masters, so they will naturally be killed one by one.

And the fact that 300 people were hammered down does not mean that 300 people died, but 200 were seriously injured, because the weather in Hejian was hot and humid, and there were no doctors to save them.

When the army of the Northern Wolf Family went south, the long summer ended and it was almost autumn. The time in the book was still two or three months away from this point, and the temperature was incomparable.

Besides, in the Game of Thrones world, doctors are in short supply, and the maesters of each castle serve as doctors.

The level of poisoning is high, and most of the treatments are done with poppy milk.

There is no hope, it cannot be cured, just drink poppy milk and wait for death!

And there is another problem, the sword of the Dawn is strong, but it is a knight who uses a sword.

The Westeros soldiers, who are called by the horse king to wear iron clothes, are all soldiers in full iron armor.

In the series, there are many mistakes in armor. Robb, the King of the North, doesn't even have calf armor and iron boots. Is it possible?

The effect of swords in breaking armor is far inferior to that of hammers.

In the wrong spring of 281, at the tournament of Harrenhal, Prince Rhaegar defeated the fearless gossip Stan and became the first.

But two years later, he was hammered to death by Robert Baratheon who used a sledgehammer at the Ruby Beach.

Why?

On the battlefield, only those who can break armor are the gods of war.

As for bows and arrows, the effect of breaking armor is not very good.

As for crossbows, I have only seen the kind of crossbows with joysticks that Joffrey played with. I have not seen them being equipped on a large scale by the army.

The bed crossbows and the like only appeared in the later period when shooting dragons, and they seemed to be useless in the early period.

After all, in the handmade era, those large crossbow arrows were very expensive, and it was not cost-effective to kill several people with one arrow.

It would be cheaper to let the soldiers go up and chop them.

The advantage of low human rights.

So I think the combat power has not collapsed. If you have any questions, you are the main one.
